matches.rationale: No finding identifies the altered Equation (1) passage defining pseudo-features through the explicit truncated SVD. Finding 3 instead relies on the removed P_k X_k Q construction, while the other findings concern different equations or algorithm steps.

The paper passage defines the leverage score as the norm of the explicitly defined j-th row of U_k^(i). Finding 1 instead attributes to Equation (5) the removed e_{i,j}^T U_k^(i) notation and a full-SVD degeneracy argument, so it does not identify the stated defect in the visible passage.

Finding 2 concretely identifies that Equation (9) defines a different TTS loss from Equation (7), including incompatible normalization and separate versus concatenated softmax treatment. This is the same temperature-scaling/objective inconsistency, regardless of which equation is treated as erroneous.

It correctly identifies the incompatible Equation (7) and Equation (9) TTS definitions.
It raises a distinct row-mixing problem involving left orthogonal encryption and sample identities, rather than the stated Equation (1) defect.
It identifies a separate global-versus-client-local normalization problem in Equation (6).
It reports a separate control-flow issue in Algorithm 1 concerning first-task pseudo-feature uploads.
